blocks.html:
When alterations, extensions or repairs to existing gas meter piping or gas distribution piping require the shut-off of gas flow to a building, the utility company shall be notified by the owner or the owner's authorized representative.
(Am. L.L. 2024/128, 12/21/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2024/128.
